stage.deleteCornersTitle: Delete the corner points and detect the cards again
stage.autoHint: Hold the cards where the subject will be and make sure they are fully visible. As soon as they are detected, the app takes the still image itself and switches the camera off.

gray.intro: Here you set the exposure. Hold the gray cards where the subject will be and adjust the light or the camera until the dot lies in the bright normal range.
gray.wrong: These are not gray cards. Hold both gray cards in front of the camera.
